title: Instrumented 5xx trace collector and guided retry thermostat for hosted API escalations
creator: Aisha Khan
description: During a recent customer escalation we observed cohorts of hosted API requests transitioning into prolonged timeout/5xx waves caused by interaction of client retries, proxy connection hold, and KV-cache thrash. This ticket implements an instrumented collector to surface per-tenant 5xx trace patterns and installs a guided retry thermostat that can throttle client retry momentum and apply graceful degradation rules while preserving customer SLAs.
steps_to_reproduce: Simulate a tenant burst by replaying recorded request traces (10x normal QPS) including streaming sessions and multipart uploads
Inject transient edge-proxy latency (100-500ms) and delay KV cache read/write by 50-150ms
Observe hosted API edge returning cascading 5xx and repeated client retries until socket pool exhaustion
acceptance_criteria: Per-tenant 5xx trace collector deployed to staging and collecting sampled traces within 10s of an anomaly
Guided retry thermostat reduces retry amplification by >=60% for synthetic tenant bursts in staging without increasing error-rate for control tenants
Dashboard shows clear before/after metrics (5xx rate, median latency, retry amplification factor) and alert thresholds are documented
Runbook updated with playbook steps and rollback gated flag for the thermostat feature
updates: 2026-03-10: Triage call with SRE, Runtime and SDK owners. Decided to prototype server-side 'thermostat' to interpose adaptive admission control rather than pushing immediate client SDK changes.

2026-03-11: PoC collector implemented (staging) that tags traces by tenant, request-type, and retry-token. Initial sampling rate 1/1000 requests. Performance impact measured: +0.8% CPU on edge proxies.

2026-03-12: Design review with PM/Design. Trade-off: aggressive thermostat could cause perceived throttling for premium customers. Agreed on policy hierarchy: (1) priority fastpath, (2) guided retry attenuation, (3) soft degrade routes to cached model variant.
2026-03-13: SDK owners reviewed idempotency-token alignment. Found mismatch in token propagation for multipart uploads; created follow-up ENG-486254 to add token propagation tests.
2026-03-14: Canary plan approved. Will route 2% of traffic from low-risk tenants in us-west-2 through thermostat for 24h with elevated telemetry. Immediate alert if customer-visible errors rise >5%.
Notes: Customer comms draft prepared for on-call and SE teams with suggested mitigations and recommended immediate steps for impacted customers.
technical_notes: Collector schema: tenant_id, request_id, retry_token, upstream_latency_ms, kvcache_hit, kernel_path, model_variant, timestamp
Thermostat algorithm: exponentially weighted moving average of per-tenant retry amplification factor with decay=0.6; threshold hysteresis to avoid flapping
Admission control points: frontdoor proxy (reject fast), host-routing layer (quarantine), runtime (fallback to quantized variant)
Mitigations considered: SDK-side bounded retries, server-side per-tenant leaky-bucket, transparent server-generated backoff header. Chosen: server-side thermostat + advisory backoff header for SDKs
Idempotency: ensure all mutation-like requests include idempotency tokens before applying early fast-fail; multipart upload compatibility requires token propagation fix (ENG-486254)
Observability: sample traces stored 7 days in hot store and 30 days in cold store; correlate with billing events for tenant-scoped debug
rollout_plan: Stage 1 (staging): instrumented collector enabled at sampling=1/1000 across staging clusters
Stage 2 (canary): enable thermostat for 2% traffic of opt-in low-risk tenants in us-west-2 for 24 hours
Stage 3 (gradual ramp): increase to 10% over 72 hours, review SLA metrics at each step
Stage 4 (global): enable by default with policy defaults but allow tenant opt-out and per-account overrides for enterprise customers
rollback_plan: Flip feature flag off (thermostat-disabled) via deploy-safe kill switch
Revert collector sampling to previous baseline
Immediate customer-facing mitigation: route affected tenants to dedicated capacity or reserved fastpath until full rollback complete
postmortem_actions: Add automated tenant-heatmap alert to detect retry amplification >3x within 5 minutes (ENG-486260)
Document SDK recommended retry semantics and coordinate release with SDK teams
Add integration test that replays historical incident trace to CI once a week
Schedule a tabletop with support and SE teams to review communication templates after canary completes
